theme_archetype.name: Archetype 5: Jewel & Luxury (Dark Theme)
theme_archetype.rationale: The app is a premium mall loyalty PWA. The splash screen established a 'Kinetic Luxury' aesthetic with dark chocolate and gold. To fix the 'jarring transition' to plain inner pages, we must carry this luxurious, deep, dark theme across all screens, utilizing glassmorphism, metallic accents, and fluid motion.

surfaces_and_textures.shimmer_effect: relative overflow-hidden before:absolute before:inset-0 before:-translate-x-full before:animate-[shimmer_2s_infinite] before:bg-gradient-to-r before:from-transparent before:via-white/10 before:to-transparent

motion_and_interactions.kinetic_tilt: Apply framer-motion useMotionValue and useTransform to create a subtle 3D tilt effect on the Home Points Card and Wallet Balance Card based on touch coordinates.

home_page.points_card: Redesign as a premium 'physical' digital card. Use kinetic_tilt. Include a gold foil gradient background and a subtle shimmer. Data-testid: 'home-points-card'.
home_page.quick_actions: Replace plain circles with glass_panel rounded-2xl squares. Icons should be gold and have a subtle hover lift. Data-testid: 'quick-action-btn'.
home_page.banner: Use 'mall_luxury_banner' image with a bottom gradient fade into the dark background to avoid hard edges.

wallet_page.balance_card: Centerpiece of the page. Should have a glowing aura behind it (e.g., div with blur-3xl bg-gold/20).
wallet_page.tier_progress: A sleek, thin progress bar with a luminous gold fill and a glowing dot at the current position.

explore_stores.search_bar: Glassmorphism input with gold focus ring. Data-testid: 'store-search-input'.
explore_stores.category_pills: Horizontal scrollable list. Active pill is border-[#C9A55A] text-[#C9A55A], inactive is border-white/10 text-[#A3988B].
explore_stores.store_cards: Bento-style grid. Cards must use glass_panel with the store image acting as a background layer heavily dimmed (bg-black/60) so text is readable. Data-testid: 'explore-store-card'.

tier_journey.layout: Vertical timeline ladder. Each tier is a card that reveals on scroll.
tier_journey.visuals: Use 'diamond_tier_reward' image for the top tier. Apply respective tier colors (bronze, silver, gold, platinum, titanium, diamond, privilege) as subtle glows or text gradients. Active tier has a gold_panel. Data-testid: 'tier-journey-card'.

profile.header: Avatar surrounded by a gold ring. Member since and points clearly visible.
profile.info_card: A stacked list inside a glass_panel. Each row separated by a subtle border-b border-white/10.

component_usage.icons: Use lucide-react (already installed) with minimal strokeWidth (e.g., 1.5) for elegance.
component_usage.buttons: Primary buttons: solid gold (#C9A55A) background, dark chocolate text (#1A0F00), rounded-full, with tap_scale animation.
component_usage.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid. e.g., 'scan-bill-btn', 'redeem-btn'.
